integrity: The arbitrary-dimension proof derives the norm directly from the published vertex coordinates, identifies the bar pattern with a Dyck path, proves every area level occurs, and fixes the minimum-ball center using uniqueness plus the published simultaneous permutation symmetry. Finite enumeration is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Ardila's specific integral realization of the bipermutahedron and the Euclidean metric induced from the ambient coordinate space. It gives all distinct vertex radii and the outer-shell multiplicity, but not multiplicities of every intermediate shell. Search-based originality assessment can miss unindexed or differently phrased work.
title: Exact Euclidean radial spectrum of the bipermutahedron
